title: finding(app-shell,tests): the `permission-slice.authoredKeys` scanner matches `setDraft(` inside a `//` comment, so its region runs to end of file and reads every later leading-spread literal in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` as an authored facet
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with named sites in a repo gate (class a: a pin that reads the wrong region). Measured by two parties. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`). The source is the objectui#5987 dev report (PR objectui#10754, addendum `5853090672`). The at-tier contract review of that PR reproduced it on `main` and at both PR heads. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/permission-slice.authoredKeys.test.ts` (added by PR objectui#4534 for #4302), `scanDraftAuthoredKeys`, read by the seat on objectui `origin/main` `704e05b09d`:
- `const CALL = /\bsetDraft\s*\(/g;` (`:184`) runs over the raw source, comments included. `balanced(src, …)` (`:84`) is then called from the matched `(`.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:617` is a `//` comment: `// funnels through setDraft (matrix checkboxes, header inputs, capabilities,`. The `)` that would close that parenthesis sits on the next comment line. `balanced` skips comments wholesale through `skipComment` (`:68`), so it never sees the `)`.
- ⇒ The "call" region never closes and runs to end of file. The contract review's replica measured the region at lines 617 to 1603 on `main`.

## The consequence

- The test's own header says the scan reads the object literals inside `setDraft(...)` calls. In practice it reads **every** leading-spread literal from line 617 to EOF as a candidate authored facet.
- `main` is green only because every such literal below that line happens to carry a key in the carried set.
- PR objectui#10754's first head added the action runner's dispatch argument `{ ...localized, objectName, params }` below the comment. `Test (shard 1/8)` went red with `expected [ 'objectName', 'params' ] to deeply equal []`, flagging keys that are not permission-set facets. The PR worked around it by moving the literal into a helper file the scan does not read.
- The next leading-spread literal written into the editor will trip it the same way. Or, if it carries a real facet key, it will pass for the wrong reason.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Fix the scanner, not the editor. Either option works:
- skip comments before matching `CALL`;
- or refuse an unterminated region, as the header's anti-blind floor (`SCAN_FLOOR`) already refuses an empty scan.

Pins:
- a `setDraft (` mention in a comment opens no region;
- an unterminated region is refused loudly;
- the key set on `main` is unchanged: `objects, fields, name, label, systemPermissions`, per the review's replica.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (back to 2026-09-20), read by REST, matched against `authoredKeys`, `scanDraftAuthoredKeys`, `setDraft … (comment|scanner|region)` and `unterminated region`. The only hit is the closed PR objectui#10449, which touched the test for another reason. No card names this defect.

Dedupe words: `authoredKeys scanner setDraft comment` · `scanDraftAuthoredKeys unterminated region` · `permission-slice authoredKeys runaway`
